scope: Literal source susceptibility contrast/identifiability audit before model fitting; not phenotype admission or original target evaluation
source_version: Pinned author TSV, not a merged receptor-label version
literal_states: Only exact Yes and No form complete binary-state pairs for descriptive counting. All other strings remain separate with literal exclusions; no Resistant conversion or production-host labels.
partition: Keep every one of the five existing 260-member role buckets; never move members based on susceptibility.
contrast: Count BW25113=Yes/BL21=No and the reverse separately, including genomic group counts and identifiers.
identifiability: If both opposite orientations occur, a single fixed host ordering cannot perfectly satisfy all comparisons. If only one orientation occurs, a suitable fixed host ordering can satisfy every descriptive mixed-state comparison. This logical diagnostic is not a fitted or evaluated predictor.
training_decision: No labels admitted, model trained, original coverage added or both-unseen contract relaxed.
